about_the_game:
WISHLIST TODAY!

WELCOME TO THE MONTEREY JACK CHEESE FACTORY… WHERE NIGHTMARES ARE AGED TO PERFECTION.

When high school junior Gordi enters the abandoned Monterey Jack Cheese Factory searching for his missing best friend Mikey, he soon realizes something is terribly wrong. The factory is haunted by its deranged owner, Monterey Jack, a monstrous figure with a grotesque cheese head and a sinister grin. But Jack is not alone. Thanks to his cursed cheese dip, everything that touches it—dolls, mannequins, and even factory machines—springs to life in horrifying, twisted forms. Armed with nothing but a slingshot and the light from his phone, Gordi must navigate the factory’s dark corridors, solve cryptic puzzles, and uncover the terrifying truth before he too becomes part of Monterey Jack’s monstrous feast.


Enemies have detailed hitboxes, requiring players to use their slingshot to find weak spots.

OUTRUN, OUTSMART, AND SURVIVE… IF YOU CAN.

Monterey Jack is always watching, always hunting. The factory’s winding halls and cavernous storage rooms offer multiple paths and secrets, letting you choose how to escape—but Jack is relentless. Along the way, you’ll encounter a grotesque cast of cheese-infested horrors, from melting cheese people that reform like the T-1000 to soulless dolls stuffed with living cheese. Use makeshift weapons like nail guns, mousetraps, and fire extinguishers to hold off these abominations long enough to escape. But beware—the factory itself is a puzzle, and every choice you make will shape the ending you get.


Run, run, run as fast as you can. You can't escape the cheese man!

DON'T LET THE CHEESE GET ON YOU!

Monterey Jack’s latest in-house creation—his infamous cheese dip—turns anything into a nightmare-fueled killing machine. Drop a doll in? Killer dolls. A person? Cheese zombies. Yourself? Well… you get the idea. Monterey Jack features a wild cast of grotesque cheese monsters, intense boss fights, and a gooey, terrifying survival horror experience you won’t forget!


Solve puzzles and uncover clues to reveal the secrets of the cheese factory.

HORROR, REINVENTED.

Monterey Jack offers a solid 3 to 4-hour horror experience packed with terrifying encounters, intense chases, and heart-stopping jumpscares. With multiple endings, leaderboards, and even a horde mode, the factory’s nightmares don’t end when the story does. Will you uncover the truth behind Monterey Jack’s twisted legacy? Or will you become just another ingredient in his sinister cheese recipe?


If you’re craving a cheese-filled survival horror experience, don’t miss out! Hit that wishlist button and join the Discord to stay updated on all things Monterey Jack! Your fate—and the factory’s secrets—await.

content_descriptors.notes: Players will encounter grotesque cheese-themed monsters, including the terrifying Monterey Jack, who relentlessly hunts them. The game features scenes of violence, including melee and ranged combat against nightmarish creatures.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Quad core processor
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 2070 or AMD RX 5700 XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: In game settings to adjust for lower end machines.

short_description: Welcome to the Monterey Jack Cheese Factory—where the cheese bites back! Armed with a slingshot and your wits, survive the relentless pursuit of Monterey Jack, a monstrous cheese-headed madman, and his gooey army of living dairy nightmares.

English*, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Japanese, Simplified Chinese, Portuguese - Brazil
*languages with full audio support
